public_rationale: Anthropic began trading on November 19, 2026, placing its six-month anniversary in May 2027, after the November 24 evaluation date [e1]. The November 23 account describes prospective, staged share releases; it does not establish that roughly nine billion shares have become eligible or that holders have sold them widely [e2]. Neither item establishes the eligibility and completed sales required for early resolution, so the forecast remains unresolved and not due [e1, e2].
limitations: The approximate nine-billion eligible-share total has not been reconciled against final registrations, awards and release conditions.
The packet contains no completed sales evidence for the future six-month release window.
May 31, 2027 is the contract's operational endpoint, not an exact deadline stated by the speaker.
The claim supplies no quantitative threshold for widespread selling.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: When around 9 billion Anthropic shares become tradable around six months after the IPO, they will be dumped en masse.
conditions: after lockup around six months post-IPO
public_payload.original_horizon_text: Around six months from going public

statement.excerpt: Around six months from going public, around 9 billion shares of Anthropic stock can be traded on the market, and based on the activity so far, they’ll be dumped en masse.

from_speaker: Around six months from going public
can be traded on the market
our_interpretation: Treat the forecast as conditional on roughly nine billion shares becoming eligible for public sale near the six-month IPO anniversary.
The plain reading of dumped en masse is substantial, widespread selling by holders whose restrictions have lifted. Eligibility alone, ordinary turnover or a price decline alone does not establish it.
Use May 2027 as the approximate six-month window and May 31 as its operational endpoint. The speaker supplied no exact tolerance for around.
The nine-billion figure is read as approximate total eligible shares, not necessarily nine billion newly unlocked shares.
criteria.support_condition: The eligibility condition occurs, and sale disclosures and attributable trading evidence show substantial, widespread selling around the relevant release.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The eligibility condition occurs, but sufficiently complete ownership and sale records show that holders largely retain their newly tradable holdings through the relevant window.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verify whether roughly nine billion shares become eligible near May 2027, then examine attributable holder sales and ownership records through the contract's May 31 window. Substantial, widespread selling would support the forecast; sufficiently complete records showing holders largely retained their newly tradable shares would contradict it.
